headline: KC jumps 50.00% on the day, extending a 5‑day gain after its debt‑restructuring filing.
market_take: Today's coverage shows a sharp rally in PROP led by KC (+50.00%) while several PROP names slipped, notably EVER (-22.22%) and PF (-20.00%). CONS stocks were mixed, with TRC up 16.36% on strong volume and TTCL down 33.33% after a hearing on its rehabilitation petition. FOOD displayed high volatility, highlighted by AQUA's -10.00% open gap and a +22.22% intraday swing, and XBIO's -14.29% move amid a SET clarification filing.
